quotes.text: You must complete a minimum of 60 credits.

gaps: Residency: at least 15 credits (normally the final 15) must be taken through UMGC, but the capture does not tie this to any specific requirement, so no line is marked institutionalOnly.

WRTG 112 must be completed with a grade of C- or better within the first 24 credits and may not be earned through Prior Learning (Portfolio or Course Challenge); the ledger schema has no field for grade/timing conditions.

Mathematics must be completed within the first 24 credits; the professional exploration course (PACE 111) is to be taken as the first course; these sequencing conditions are not captured in the ledger fields.

The research skills requirement states 'LIBS 150, CAPL 398A, and any general education courses apply'; the capture does not clarify whether a course used elsewhere in general education may double-count here.
The capture names the 'mathematics course approved by the department' option but does not list which additional courses are approved.

Focused elective options (accounting and finance, business and management, computer studies, criminal justice, foreign language area studies, military history, psychology) are optional ways to fill the 21 interdisciplinary elective credits and are not itemized as separate requirements.
Minimum 2.0 GPA in all courses taken through UMGC and pass/fail exclusion for general education courses are overall policies not represented as ledger lines.
Catalog year is printed with spaced characters ('2 0 2 6 – 2 0 2 7') in page footers; requirements apply to students beginning continuous enrollment on or after August 1, 2026.
